column1: # Evidence-backed symbol names for the RE2-64 decompilation corpus.
# Consumed by tools/make_seeds.py, which filters this file to one image's address range and
# writes the TSV that REA_GHIDRA_SEED_FILE expects (address<TAB>kind<TAB>name). Names enter
# Ghidra *before* auto-analysis, which is the only route that persists — session renames are
# RULE: a name here must be backed by a measurement, cited in the evidence column. A function
# whose role is inferred rather than demonstrated stays func_XXXXXXXX. Two verification gates
# apply: (1) the address must be a function start — a prologue `addiu sp,sp,-N`, or a proven
# call/vector target for handlers and leaves that have no frame; (2) after decompilation the
# body must still show the behaviour in the evidence column, or the name is demoted.
#   kind: function (creates a function boundary) | label (name only)
